remarks: Charming meets modern in this beautifully renovated single family home in Norwalk. This 3 bedroom, 2.5-bath residence blends timeless character with thoughtful updates throughout. Sunlight pours into every room, highlighting the home's original charm alongside its fresh, elevated finishes.  The spacious layout features a stunning primary suite complete with a private en suite bath, while two additional bedrooms offer flexibility for guests, home office, or family living. The designer bathrooms showcase stylish wallpaper accents, adding a unique and sophisticated touch.  At the heart of the home, the updated kitchen is both functional and inviting, complete with a wine fridge-perfect for entertaining or unwinding at the end of the day. Set on a level lot, the outdoor space offers ease of use and potential for relaxing or hosting.  A rare rental opportunity that delivers both character and modern comfort. This is Norwalk living at its best.
